entries.wording: 快件电子信息已经收到 Shipment information received
entries.note: In the tracking example of HuaHan's API documentation: the order data. Scan texts give the Chinese wording, then the English one.

entries.wording: Shipment information received
entries.note: The same scan in English only, in the documentation's later tracking example.

entries.wording: 运单电子信息已收到
entries.note: In the tracking example of HuaHan's API documentation: the latest-event summary listed beside a parcel that has only its order data.

entries.wording: 快件到达作业中心 Shipment arrived at facility
entries.note: In the tracking example of HuaHan's API documentation: HuaHan's operations centre in Shenzhen receiving the parcel, its first scan after the order data.

entries.wording: Has entered the warehouse
entries.note: The same code in the documentation's later tracking example: HuaHan's warehouse in Shenzhen received the parcel.

entries.wording: 快件到达作业中心
entries.note: The latest-event summary form of the arrival at HuaHan's operations centre, in the documentation's later tracking example.

entries.wording: 快件操作完成 Shipment departed from facility
entries.note: In the tracking example of HuaHan's API documentation: the parcel left HuaHan's operations centre in Shenzhen.

entries.wording: 快件操作完成
entries.note: In the tracking example of HuaHan's API documentation: the latest-event summary form of the departure from the operations centre.

entries.wording: Arrived at origin facility
entries.note: HuaHan's receipt at its origin facility in its English words, relayed by a tracking provider under the provider's own code: the wording gives the stage.

entries.wording: Departed from origin facility
entries.note: HuaHan's departure from its origin facility in its English words, relayed the same way.

entries.wording: Data processed
entries.note: Relayed by 17TRACK without a code, between the parcel's departures from the origin facility.

entries.wording: Transfer to Origin airport
entries.note: The parcel moving from the origin facility to the departure airport.

entries.wording: Export customs clearance completed
entries.note: Export clearance at the origin, before the flight.

entries.wording: Departed from airport of Origin
entries.note: The flight leaving the origin.

entries.wording: Import Customs clearance started
entries.note: Import clearance opening at the destination gateway.

entries.wording: Arrived at destination airport
entries.note: The flight landing at the destination gateway.

entries.wording: Import Customs clearance completed
entries.note: Import clearance released, before the hand-off to the destination carrier.

entries.wording: Has been given to local carrier
entries.note: HuaHan handing the parcel to the destination carrier after import clearance; the partner's scans follow it.

entries.wording: We will pick up your parcel from the sender soon.
entries.note: The destination carrier's notice from its pre-advice, between the order data and HuaHan's receipt in Shenzhen.

entries.wording: Pendiente de recepción en CTT Express
entries.note: CTT Express's notice of the parcel coming, its own pre-advice wording (code 0000), relayed without a code hours before HuaHan's receipt in Shenzhen.

entries.wording: The parcel was redirected. As soon as it is in the couriers possession, it will be processed as requested.
entries.note: The destination carrier's record of the recipient's redirection, written while the parcel was still in China: it moves nothing.

entries.wording: Ready to Ship, Parcel received and processed
entries.note: The destination carrier's receipt after the hand-off; HuaHan accepted the parcel in China.

entries.wording: Shipped
entries.note: Relayed without a code after the destination carrier's receipt.

entries.wording: Change of delivery address
entries.note: The destination carrier's record of a new delivery address, relayed without a code after the hand-off; the parcel is still on its way.

entries.wording: The parcel is in the central warehouse waiting to be processed.
In Transit, Shipment arrived to sorting centre / Shipment in the sorting centre
In Transit
The parcel is on the way to the local warehouse.
In Transit, Shipment remained at sorting hub
In Transit, Arrived to HU HUB
entries.note: The destination carrier's hub in Hungary, after its receipt.

entries.wording: In Transit, Parcel has entered the Linehaul network.
entries.note: The destination carrier's trunk route between its hubs, after the hub scan.

entries.wording: In Transit, Picked Up | Einrollung
entries.note: DPD's depot inbound scan (Einrollung) after the hand-off, not an acceptance: HuaHan accepted the parcel in China.

entries.wording: In Transit, Scanned By DPD At parcel delivery centre.
entries.note: DPD's depot scan after the hand-off, relayed under HuaHan's code, on each day the parcel waits there.

entries.wording: In Transit, At parcel delivery centre.
entries.note: The destination carrier's depot, after its depot scans.

entries.wording: Delivery Attempted
entries.note: DPD's attempt after its out-for-delivery, relayed without a code.

entries.wording: Delivery Attempted, Unfortunately we have not been able to deliver your parcel. Pickup parcelshop delivery after first delivery attempt.
entries.note: DPD's attempt, with the parcel going on to a pickup point.

entries.wording: Awaiting Pickup, Parcel was deposited in Pickup parcel station
entries.note: DPD left the parcel at a pickup point for its recipient after the attempt.

entries.wording: The courier will deliver the parcel soon. Additional details are available in the SAMEDAY app, email or SMS.
entries.note: The destination carrier's own words for the scan HuaHan codes CB, at the same instant.

entries.wording: Out for Delivery, Parcel is at courier, delivery expected soon.
entries.note: The destination carrier's courier scan, relayed under HuaHan's code.

entries.wording: Delivered, Parcel was delivered successfully
entries.note: The destination carrier's delivery, relayed under HuaHan's code with that carrier's wording.

entries.wording: The parcel has been successfully delivered.
entries.note: A second delivery wording from the same destination carrier under the same code.

entries.wording: Received by airport of Origin
entries.note: The origin airport's receipt, after export clearance and before the departure from it.

entries.wording: 货物离开操作中心
entries.note: Leaving the transfer warehouse, after the origin airport's receipt.

entries.wording: 快件从转运仓发出至机场，出口报关中（ The package is shipped from the transfer warehouse to the airport Export customs clearance in progress ）
entries.note: Export clearance under way.

entries.wording: 快件抵达机场，预计14号航班飞（The parcel has arrived at the airport and is currently being loaded onto a flight; it is scheduled to depart on 14 ）
entries.note: The day of the planned flight varies.

entries.wording: 航班延误，重新配载至15号航班飞（Flight delayed; rebooked onto flight 15）
entries.note: A delay, the parcel rebooked onto the day's flight it names.

entries.wording: 目的国清关完成 (Customs clearance in the destination country has been completed
entries.note: Import clearance done, before the hand-off to the destination carrier.

entries.wording: Picked up by Shipping Partner
entries.note: An American partner's scan relayed while the parcel was still in China, before its flight: written ahead, not the parcel's acceptance.

entries.wording: Arrived Shipping Partner Facility
entries.note: The same partner's scan, also before the flight.

entries.wording: Departed Shipping Partner Facility
entries.note: The same partner's scan; the line goes on with its time and place.
